title: Sections of a sheaf are determined by their germs
statement: Let $X$ be a topological space, $\mathcal F$ a sheaf of sets (or of rings) on $X$ and $U\subseteq X$ open. If $s,t\in\mathcal F(U)$ have the same germ $s_x=t_x\in\mathcal F_x$ at every $x\in U$, then $s=t$; i.e. $\mathcal F(U)\to\prod_{x\in U}\mathcal F_x$ is injective.

mathlib_searches.query: two sections of a sheaf with equal germs at every point are equal
